If 'W' stands for '÷', 'Y' stands for '×', 'Z' stands for '+' and 'A' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

11 W 11 Y 11 Z 11 A 11 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 11 W 11 Y 11 Z 11 A 11 = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png]

 Alphabet
 W
 Y
 Z
 A
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**11 ÷ 11**__ × 11 + 11 - 11 = ?

⇒ __**1 × 11**__ + 11 - 11 = ?

⇒ __22** - 11**__ = **11**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1and 3 is not allowed.)

(3, 34, 5)

(10, 136, 6)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² + (3rd number)² = 2nd number.

Now,

For, (3, 34, 5)

⇒ (3)² + (5)² = 9 + 25 = 34.

For, (10, 136, 6)

⇒ (10)2 + (6)2 = 100 + 36 = 136.

Similarly, for **(7, 113, 8)**

**⇒ (7)2 + (8)2 = 49 + 64 = 113.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pillow is a cushion.

All cushions are sheets.

No sheet is a blanket.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No cushion is a blanket.

(II) Some pillows are sheets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8afc630c1bf96121316ff12864621cdf2fdef3548ebe0b2135666996ec42054.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No cushion is a blanket → Follow (As all cushions are sheets and no sheet is a blanket. As whole cushions comes in sheets which can not be blanket, therefore no cushion is blanket is true.)

II. Some pillows are sheets → **Does not** follow (As all cushions are sheets and no pillow is a cushion. It is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 16 September 2010 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 August 2017?
questions.solution:
Given: **16 September 2010** was Thursday.

Now,

2010 to 2017 = 7 Years (5 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 5 Ordinary Years have 5 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 5 = 9.

9 odd days → 9/7 = 1 week and 2 odd days.

then, 16 September 2017 will be Thursday + 2 = Saturday.

Now, the number of days between **17 August 2017 to 16 September 2017**

= 14 (August) + 16 (September) = 30 days.

= 30 days → 30/7 = 4 weeks and 2 odd days.

So, **17 August 2017** will be Saturday - 2 = Thursday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
If 'A' stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

96 B 3 D 285 A 5 C 11 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 96 B 3 D 285 A 5 C 11 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 96 × 3 - __**285 ÷ 5**__ + 11 = ?

⇒ __**96 × 3**__ - 57 + 11 = ?

⇒ __**288**__ - 57 **__+ 11__** = ?

⇒ **__299__****__ - 57__** = __242__.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
